note: Candidate explanations with citations. Nothing here is a finding of this dashboard; items are surfaced for the reader to judge.

topics.label: Immunity wall / immunity debt
topics.question: Does a large prior season suppress the next one?
topics.query: TITLE_ABS:("immunity debt" OR "immunity gap" OR "immunity wall") AND TITLE_ABS:(respiratory OR influenza OR RSV OR children)

topics.label: Influenza severity & H3N2 subclade K
topics.question: Why is influenza activity so far below prior years?
topics.query: TITLE_ABS:(influenza) AND TITLE_ABS:("subclade K" OR H3N2) AND TITLE_ABS:(season OR severity OR "vaccine effectiveness")

topics.label: Parainfluenza / croup burden
topics.question: Is the off-season parainfluenza elevation documented elsewhere?
topics.query: TITLE_ABS:(parainfluenza OR croup) AND TITLE_ABS:(children OR pediatric OR paediatric)

topics.label: SARS-CoV-2 variant landscape
topics.question: Is a new variant driving the wastewater rise?
topics.query: TITLE_ABS:("SARS-CoV-2" AND (variant OR lineage)) AND TITLE_ABS:("immune evasion" OR "immune escape" OR transmissibility OR wastewater)

topics.label: RSV nirsevimab & maternal vaccine
topics.question: Could prophylaxis explain suppressed RSV rather than immunity?
topics.query: TITLE_ABS:(nirsevimab OR "RSV vaccine" OR "maternal vaccination") AND TITLE_ABS:(effectiveness OR impact OR hospitalisation OR hospitalization OR bronchiolitis)

topics.label: Invasive Group A Strep
topics.question: Is iGAS still running above pre-pandemic baseline?
topics.query: TITLE_ABS:("group A streptococcus" OR iGAS OR "scarlet fever") AND TITLE_ABS:(invasive OR surveillance OR incidence OR children)
